description: Authors or improves one atomic neutral skill and emits requested Claude Code or Codex adapters. Use when a user asks to create, refactor, tighten, or add evals to a skill without installing or activating it.
intent: Create or improve one atomic neutral skill source.
outcome: Produce one contract-valid skill, its eval set, and requested thin surface adapters.
non_goals: Author MCPs agents hooks commands or apps
inputs: Concrete user intent and trigger examples
Baseline artifact or explicit no-skill baseline

permissions.allowed_scope: Owner-selected proposal or candidate-sandbox root only

positive: add evals and reliable triggers to one skill
negative: package existing skills as a plugin

lifecycle.promotion_gate: Same-model paired authoring tasks on Claude Code and Codex plus owner approval

instructions: Confirm the reusable intent, realistic positive triggers, near misses, bounded inputs, and one independently measurable outcome.
Record a no-skill or prior-version baseline before final prose and define at least three positive eval cases plus one realistic near miss.
Split the request when two outcomes can fail independently; record explicit non-goals for adjacent intents.
Author the neutral record first, keeping shared instructions concise, imperative, one reference level deep, and free of live dynamic shell injection.
Use source-visible deterministic scripts only for fragile repeatable behavior and state whether each resource is read or run.
Generate Claude Code and Codex adapters from the neutral source; keep Codex UI metadata in agents/openai.yaml and surface-only fields out of the neutral body.
Validate the contract, adapters, scripts, and eval set; return reviewable proposal files and evidence without installing or activating them.
